provenance.plan: Existing Baidu north-up satellite snapshot retained 2026-10-22; manual plan interpretation. Capture date unknown.
provenance.roads: Image-traced road centrelines, not a navigable graph. Navigation references are separate BD-09 data.
provenance.trees: Illustrative vegetation sampled only in image-interpreted forest; not a census of individual trees.
provenance.buildings: Roof-block footprints interpreted from image; heights, roof detail and window patterns are illustrative and unmeasured.
provenance.terrain: Flat reference plane; no DEM and no fabricated mountain elevations.
provenance.art: Procedural ink-coloured geometric illustration; not photogrammetry.
